visual.description: Hero stat reveal. Large '570x' counter animates from 0 to 570 in JetBrains Mono, centered on screen. Suffix '×' in Accent Pink. Below the counter: 'the EU safe daily BPA limit' in Inter 400. Glow surface pulses once on landing. Dark background with film grain overlay.
visual.sourceText: Source: Jurikova et al., Environ. Sci. Pollut. Res., 2024

dataChart.title: BPA Exceedance Factor
dataChart.subtitle: Sweat-soaked polyester activewear vs EU safe daily limit

notes: Opening hook — the most shocking stat upfront. Counter should complete by ~frame 60 (2s) then hold. Glow surface emphasizes this is the headline number. No dot-grid here — film-grain keeps it cinematic for the hook.
